findings.title: Full native shader concat rejects its own header insertion
findings.impact: Default concat auto conversion inserts H264 SPS/PPS NAL units before prefix keyframes; the exact packet payload comparison fails after710visualcaptures, so the advertised full-native path cannot succeed.

evidence.method: Read-only Node MP4 stsz/stsc/stco sample-table parser on preserved accepted opening and accepted full silent film; no FFmpeg/browser/GPU run
evidence.relatedExistingProducer: workflows/assets/grifon-shader-recreation/render-full.mjs:117-118 uses the same default concat command

findings.recommendation: Use an intentionally packet-preserving compatible join verified against actual prefix/extradata and strict decoded pixels, or reject the unsupported path before capture. Do not merely disable auto_convert without decoder compatibility evidence.

findings.title: Play races unfinished sound-contact frame seeks
findings.trigger: Select an opening sound contact, then press Play while seekFullFrame still awaits the prefix video seeked event
findings.impact: draw only publishes frame after its awaited seek; Play meanwhile starts its wall clock and audio from the old frame. The selected cue can jump back and sound starts at the wrong time. Rapid pause/resume also keeps the old requestAnimationFrame chain because stop does not cancel or invalidate it.

evidence.method: Execute generated page script in an in-memory Node VM with DOM/audio stubs and a deferred seekFullFrame promise; no browser or GPU

findings.recommendation: Await completion of the requested frame before starting audio/playback and cancel or generation-guard pending RAF callbacks. Add meaningful pure async control regression coverage.

findings.title: Visual runtime key omits rendering runtime modules
findings.trigger: Selected headless shell keeps executable/revision/version but libGLESv2.dll, libEGL.dll, V8 snapshot/resources, or Playwright core implementation bytes change
findings.impact: visualRuntime only hashes ffmpeg,ffprobe,launch executable and local producer files; dependency module changes leave the same visual cache key and permit reuse under a changed actual renderer/profile implementation. This fails the stated full-runtime hash binding contract.

evidence.method: Static runtime-key field audit and installed selected browser directory inventory
evidence.playwrightImplementation: node_modules/playwright-core/lib/coreBundle.js contains chromiumSwitches/defaultArgs, yet only node_modules/playwright/package.json version is bound

findings.recommendation: Bind the selected browser runtime files and relevant Playwright core/launch implementation bytes or an equivalently complete verified distribution digest; exclude mutable log/profile files.

findings.title: Windows checkout invalidates standalone proof receipt
findings.trigger: Commit generated proof files then check them out with the current core.autocrlf=true
findings.impact: New preview-manifest.json and standalone-preview-build.json receive CRLF because they inherit text:auto/eol:unspecified. The builder hashes manifest rawbytes and compares receipt rawtext, so --check fails after a normal fresh checkout even with identical media/player.

evidence.method: Read-only git config/check-attr and builder static audit

findings.recommendation: Give all new byte-bound proof/source/receipt text explicit stable newline attributes and verify committed blob/fresh-checkout bytes before reporting reproducible backup.

limitations: No browser,GPU,FFmpeg,fullapplication tests or source/media/cache mutation performed by reviewer
